items.title: Theodore Purnell Interview, 1972-06-16
items.q: The tenor player with Prima? Yeah.

ctx.x: Yeah. I'm trying to tell this little boy, those little boys that come here all the time. Uh, you got to pee pee funtin'. He's just come here all the time. Uh, you got to pee pee funtin'. He's just come here all the time. Uh-huh. Yeah, well I remember that, but he was nobody then. He was with Phil Zeebuck. Yeah. Yeah. He wasn't any name then. used to come around around there. Boy, and this boy right now is with a, with a, shit, I can't call him, he's a trumpet player, Prima, the tenor player. I can't call his name.
The tenor player with Prima? Yeah.

It used to be Sam Butera. Yeah, yeah, me, him too. Yeah. Yeah. Well, I can tell you some of the things I don't want to do, shit, make the headstand on the knee. I remember when I first went to Chicago, I used to play baritone too, you know. I used to play the hell out of baritone. I was small, skinny, and I was small. People never heard a baritone or something like that. No, I used to play the hell out of baritone. Okay. You used to play with Frankie Duesen, you were saying? Yeah, I used to play with Frankie…
